Article 12.1: Country Restrictions & Product List

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule
Restricted Countries

Trading with FFN is prohibited in the following countries:

Afghanistan
North Korea
Azerbaijan
Pakistan
Burma (Myanmar)
Russia
Central African Republic
Somalia
Cuba
South Sudan
Haiti
Sudan
Iran
Syria
Iraq
Turkmenistan
Mali
Ukraine
Nauru
Venezuela
Nicaragua
Yemen
Nigeria

If your country is on this list, you are not eligible to trade with FFN. If you have questions about eligibility, please contact support.

 

Note: If a trader would like to trade a product outside of the CME markets (Example: NYMEX, CBOT, COMEX) please contact support via email or chat on our website: support@fundedfuturesnetwork.com
